source.name: United Center (official)
source.quote: announced a new sponsorship agreement that will ensure the naming rights of the United Center for the next 20 years
source.note: Announced 11 December 2013 for 20 years; the release does not give the year the new term starts.

note: Arena naming rights: United Center. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2013-12-11.
